sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Added a "Length info - Duration" section to the "Length" column's unique-values (📊) dropdown: recordings/tracks are bucketed into fixed "N to N+1 minutes" ranges (e.g. "0 to 1 minutes", "5 to 6 minutes"), with MusicBrainz's own "?:??" unknown-duration placeholder mapped to its own "Unknown length" entry. Checking a bucket filters the table to matching rows and highlights the matched duration text. New: _findCellLengthBucket() extractor, lengthbucket: compound structure-mode filter, _highlightLengthBucketMatch().
